profile.headline: SDE @ Amazon
profile.summary: I’m a passionate Software Developer with a love for tech and finance. Currently double majoring in Data Science and Financial Mathematics at UC Santa Barbara, I’ve gained valuable experience through two internships at Amazon, where I worked on building scalable solutions and improving user experiences. I also hold associate degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, and Mathematics. I’m always excited to take on new challenges, collaborate with others, and find creative ways to solve problems.
